options.task: See free/busy times only
options.quote: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.freebusy View your availability in your calendars.
options.note: Not on Google's restricted list (support.google.com/cloud/answer/13464325); no Google page labels this scope, so treat it as sensitive until the Cloud Console Data Access page shows otherwise.

options.task: Read events on all calendars
options.quote: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.events.readonly View events on all your calendars.
options.note: Not on Google's restricted list (support.google.com/cloud/answer/13464325); Google's scopes page gives no tier, but it reads personal event data, which Google's consent guide puts in the sensitive group.

options.task: Create or edit events only on calendars the user owns
options.quote: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.events.owned See, create, change, and delete events on Google calendars you own.
options.note: Not on Google's restricted list (support.google.com/cloud/answer/13464325); no Google page labels this scope's tier.

options.task: Create or edit events on all calendars
options.quote: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.events View and edit events on all your calendars.
options.note: Not on Google's restricted list (support.google.com/cloud/answer/13464325); no Google page labels this scope's tier.

options.task: Make its own calendars and manage events only on those
options.quote: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.app.created Make secondary Google calendars, and see, create, change, and delete events on them.
options.note: Not on Google's restricted list (support.google.com/cloud/answer/13464325); no Google page says whether this narrow scope is non-sensitive, so sensitive is the safe assumption; check the Cloud Console.

options.task: Create calendars and change calendar settings
options.quote: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.calendars See and change the properties of Google calendars you have access to, and create secondary calendars.
options.note: Not on Google's restricted list (support.google.com/cloud/answer/13464325); no Google page labels this scope's tier; editing the subscribed list needs calendar.calendarlist too.

options.task: Full access, including sharing and deleting calendars
options.quote: detailed justification for each requested sensitive scope, as well as an explanation for why a narrower scope isn't sufficient. For example: "My app will use https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar
options.note: The label comes from Google's own example of a sensitive-scope justification, not from a scope table; also not on the restricted list.

options.task: Open files the user picks or the app created
options.quote: Since drive.file is non-sensitive, it allows for a more streamlined verification process.

options.task: Store its own hidden settings in the user's Drive
options.quote: Non-sensitive scopes The following Drive API scopes are recommended for most use cases:
options.note: drive.appdata is listed in that non-sensitive table as "View and manage the app's own configuration data in your Google Drive."

options.task: See file names and details only, not contents
options.quote: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.metadata.readonly View metadata for files in your Drive.
options.note: Listed under the page's Restricted scopes table; also on Google's restricted list.

options.task: See the activity history of files
options.quote: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.activity.readonly View the activity record of files in your Drive.
options.note: Listed under the page's Restricted scopes table; also on Google's restricted list.

options.task: Read all files
options.quote: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.readonly View and download all your Drive files.
options.note: Listed under the page's Restricted scopes table; the yearly security assessment applies when the data is stored on or sent through servers.

options.task: Edit all files
options.quote: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive View and manage all your Drive files.
options.note: Listed under the page's Restricted scopes table; Google also limits restricted Drive scopes to certain app types (backup, productivity, reporting).

options.task: Read or edit only spreadsheets the user picks or the app creates
options.quote: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file See, edit, create, and delete only the specific Google Drive files you use with this app. Recommended Non-sensitive

options.task: Read all spreadsheets
options.quote: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets.readonly See all your Google Sheets spreadsheets. Sensitive

options.task: Create, edit and delete all spreadsheets
options.quote: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets See, edit, create, and delete all your Google Sheets spreadsheets. Sensitive

options.task: Search the user's Drive for any spreadsheet by name
options.quote: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.metadata.readonly View metadata for files in your Drive.
options.note: Sheets scopes have no way to list files, so finding one means calling Drive files.list; this is the narrowest Drive scope that lists all files, and Google labels it restricted.

options.task: Read channel, video and playlist data
options.quote: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.readonly View your YouTube account
options.note: Not on Google's restricted list (support.google.com/cloud/answer/13464325); no Google page labels YouTube Data API scope tiers.

options.task: Upload videos
options.quote: requires authorization with at least one of the following scopes ( read more about authentication and authorization ). Scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.upload
options.note: Not on Google's restricted list (support.google.com/cloud/answer/13464325); separately, YouTube says uploads from unverified API projects created after 28 July 2020 stay private until the project passes a YouTube compliance audit (developers.google.com/youtube/v3/revision_history).

options.task: Create and edit playlists
options.quote: Scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtubepartner https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.force-ssl
options.note: Not on Google's restricted list (support.google.com/cloud/answer/13464325); playlists.insert accepts youtubepartner, youtube or youtube.force-ssl, and Google doesn't say which is narrower; no page labels the tier.

options.task: Post and moderate comments
options.quote: requires authorization with at least one of the following scopes ( read more about authentication and authorization ). Scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.force-ssl
options.note: Not on Google's restricted list (support.google.com/cloud/answer/13464325); force-ssl is the only scope accepted for comment writes; no page labels the tier.

options.task: Read channel analytics (views, watch time)
options.quote: Important: API requests to this method now require access to the https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.readonly scope.
options.note: Not on Google's restricted list (support.google.com/cloud/answer/13464325); reports.query needs both scopes; no page labels their tier.

options.task: Read revenue and ad analytics
options.quote: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/yt-analytics-monetary.readonly View YouTube Analytics monetary reports for your YouTube content.
options.note: Not on Google's restricted list (support.google.com/cloud/answer/13464325); no page labels the tier.
